title: E0127: Command execution via system
plain_english: Passing untrusted input to `system()` can allow an attacker to execute arbitrary shell commands on the server.
why_matters: Command injection through `system()` can: - Run arbitrary system commands - Read or modify files and databases - Install malware or backdoors - Lead to full server compromise
what_it_checks: Backtick operator (`` `$cmd` ``) with tainted input (also covered by E0087)
